title: Yellow Crosshair
description: This project adds just what you think: A YELLOW CROSSHAIR
body:
This resource pack adds a yellow crosshair to minecraft. This pack is also one of four colored crosshair packs. 
Just check out my projects.

---

**Installation:**
1. Locate your `.minecraft` folder (inside `%appdata%`).  
2. Open the `resourcepacks` folder.  
3. Download this pack and place it inside the folder.  
4. Open Minecraft and activate it from the Resource Packs menu.  
5. Enjoy!  

---
